jobs.detail: broad rounded muzzle, two tiny soft ears, sleepy half-lidded funny eyes, dense caramel short plush pile, warm orange pot with subtle paw-print relief
jobs.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Create a single production-ready transparent character sprite by isolating and faithfully rebuilding ONE toy from the approved battle screen.
Input image 1: approved complete game visual, use its selected animal identity and matching pot color. Input image 2: original reference, the strict benchmark for dense, soft, fine plush fur.
Output: ONE centered full character including its flowerpot and two small felt leaves, on a genuine transparent background. Portrait canvas with 7:8 ratio, ideally 896x1024. No other objects or characters.
Registration: center at x=50%. The BOTTOM of the pot must be exactly at y=82.8125% of canvas height. All content above that baseline, keep the lower 17.1875% completely transparent for the game's dynamic ammo badge. Character including ears stays within x=8%-92%, y=6%-82.8125%. Do not crop fur tips or ears. This is an IDLE pose with relaxed playful expression, looking slightly upward toward the game board.
Render as a tactile high-end soft stuffed toy: dense individual fine SHORT plush fibers, clearly visible directional soft tufts, gentle irregular fuzzy silhouette, stuffed volume, soft upper-left lighting, subtle self-shadow. The face and muzzle are soft textile; eyes are glossy inset toy eyes. Fur must remain readable when the sprite is reduced to small UI size. Match the reference's fur warmth, length and density. No smooth plastic body, no shiny clay animal, no long shaggy hair, no spiky fibers, no white outline, no halo, no background shadow or floor.
The pot has rounded soft felt/clay texture and the SAME color family as the animal, shallow simple decoration, consistent front-facing three-quarter form like the reference. Small green felt leaves between head and pot. No pedestal, NO NUMBERS, no number badge, no text, no bubbles, no weapons, no frame, no watermark. Preserve fur fidelity and charming identity.
Selected character: caramel orange capybara. Details: broad rounded muzzle, two tiny soft ears, sleepy half-lidded funny eyes, dense caramel short plush pile, warm orange pot with subtle paw-print relief. Game color identity #FF7E27; preserve this hue in the pot's midtone while using natural lighter/darker plush shading.
